name: no-ibis-menu
description: For no-ibis: the Image Stabilizer settings (Shooting Menu 2's row, setting 296; still IS, setting 157, which Live Control checks; movie IS, setting 160) get a row check that always fails, so the menus no longer offer a stabilizer the body does not use. 7 bytes of menu data in segment 2: check-table entry 62, which no setting uses, points to an existing function that returns 1, and each of the three settings' check 84 becomes check 62. See experiments/2026-11-27-no-ibis/NOTES.md.

ops._note: app_check function table 0x7EC1C368, entry 62: 0x7E9E9836 (`clr d0; retf`, in no setting's check list; the table's three readers 0x7E9E8CCD, 0x7E9E9208, 0x7E9EA144 index it only through those lists) -> 0x7E4613E0 (kernel, `mov 1,d0; retf [],0`): the check always fails
check list of setting 296 (Image Stabilizer, Shooting Menu 2), [2, 84] at 0x7EC1C7BF, used by no other setting: 84 -> 62
check list of setting 157 (still IS, checked by Live Control), [2, 84] at 0x7EC1D014, used by no other setting: 84 -> 62
check list of setting 160 (movie IS), [2, 18, 22, 29, 84] at 0x7EC1CDE9, used by no other setting: 84 -> 62
